SELECT c.*, u.nickname AS sender_name, u.avatar AS sender_avatar FROM post_comments AS c LEFT JOIN users AS u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.status = 'normal' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comments WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND status = 'normal' AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT c.*, u.nickname AS sender_name, u.avatar AS sender_avatar, p.title AS post_title, p.user_id AS post_user_id FROM post_comments AS c LEFT JOIN users AS u ON c.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN posts AS p ON p.id = c.post_id WHERE c.status = 'pending' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comments AS c INNER JOIN posts AS p ON p.id = c.post_id WHERE c.status = 'pending' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

AND c.status = #{status}

SELECT c.id, c.post_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.title, ''), '无标题帖子') AS post_title, COALESCE(NULLIF(author.nickname, ''), author.username, '社区用户') AS post_author_name, c.content, c.status, c.created_at FROM post_comments AS c INNER JOIN posts AS p ON p.id = c.post_id LEFT JOIN users AS author ON author.id = p.user_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
